newsitem.title: BRAZIL: Brazil trade deficit seen at record $1.3 bln-paper.
newsitem.headline: Brazil trade deficit seen at record $1.3 bln-paper.

text.p: The government is due to announce an all-time record October trade deficit of $1.3 billion, a newspaper said.
Jornal do Brasil said imports rose to an unprecedented level in October to more than $5.4 billion, compared with exports of only $4.18 billion.
These figures would bring the trade deficit for the first 10 months of the year to more than $3 billion and for the whole of 1996 to between $4 billion and $5 billion, Jornal do Brasil said.
-- Simona de Logu, Rio de Janeiro newsroom, 5521 507 4151
